title: [Keyboard Manager] Per-keyboard remap profiles (auto-switch + cycle hotkey)

proposed_comments.title: Do not record virtual-key values when device resolution fails
proposed_comments.body:
### Do not record virtual-key values when device resolution fails
**Severity:** `medium`

For an unresolved-device non-modifier physical key-down, `OnRawKeyEvent` logs the virtual-key value before checking `autoSwitchEnabled`. With trace logging enabled, this can retain key identifiers even when automatic profile switching is off; the adjacent comment identifies Type Cover re-enumeration as one way to reach this branch. Please retain the dropped-event diagnostic without recording the key value.

```suggestion
        Logger::trace(L"[autosw] keydown with unresolvable device — skipped");
```

confidence.rationale: Exact current source and guards establish the diagnostic path; device-resolution failure and enabled trace logging are required. Runtime log capture was not performed.
